payload.body_you: You come home tired and {{holder1}} already knows you are not in the mood for a long conversation. They bring food, sit with you, or give you an hour without asking what is wrong. Small changes in {{holder1}}'s mood also register faster, and a quiet evening can feel more personal than it normally would.
payload.body_they: {{holder1}} may be easier to read. You notice that they need food, quiet, company, or a little more patience before {{holder1}} has to explain it. A small act can mean a lot because {{holder1}} knows you were paying attention.
